ResearchProjectDef.label: foundations of invisible arts
ResearchProjectDef.description: Study the first principles glimpsed at the edge of sleep. Unlocks basic lore compilation (Tiers 2-3), noonstone repair, and starter Lantern gear.

ResearchProjectDef.label: occult craft and vestments
ResearchProjectDef.description: Refine ritual tools and forge aspect-attuned weapons and robes. Unlocks intermediate lore compilation (Tiers 4-5), wayfarer's mirror repair, and all-aspect growth gear.

ResearchProjectDef.label: high Mansus mysteries
ResearchProjectDef.description: Synthesize the highest orders of lore and repair the watchkeeper's mirror for the final vigil. Unlocks high lore compilation (Tiers 6-7) and master focal tools.
